function.name: navigate_to
function.description: Send the robot to a predefined navigation waypoint: 'docking_station' (charging dock / home base) or 'box'.

function.name: navigate_and_deliver
function.description: Navigate to a destination ('docking_station' or 'box') and announce an item delivery on arrival.

item.description: The item or package being delivered

function.name: move_distance
function.description: Move the robot a specific distance in meters in any direction using its omnidirectional wheels without rotating heading (forward, backward, left/strafe, right/strafe, diagonal).

direction.description: Direction to move holonomically: 'forward', 'backward', 'left' (strafe left), 'right' (strafe right), 'forward_left', 'forward_right', 'backward_left', 'backward_right'. Default is 'forward'.

distance_meters.description: Distance to travel in meters (positive number, e.g. 0.5, 1.0, 2.5)

function.name: rotate
function.description: Rotate the robot by degrees in place. Positive = counterclockwise (left), negative = clockwise (right).

degrees.description: Angle in degrees to rotate (positive = counterclockwise / left, negative = clockwise / right)

function.name: stop
function.description: Cancel all robot motion immediately and brake in place.
